title: selloa ligulata
intro: Selloa ligulata, commonly known as Western yarrow, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Selloa ligulata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive constituents of Selloa ligulata may also have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its overall therapeutic value.
